description: React component for displaying system policy indicators with customizable views and interactions, including handling multiple policies and rendering different message variants.

classes.name: SystemPolicyIndicator
classes.description: React functional component for displaying system-level access policies with different display variants.

methods.name: handleMorePoliciesClick
methods.description: Handles click or keyboard events to trigger the onMorePoliciesClick callback.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events for accessibility, triggering the click handler on Enter or Space.

methods.name: getPolicyDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given policy, defaulting to 'Unknown Policy' if name and id are missing.

methods.name: renderPolicyList
methods.description: Renders a list of policies, showing first two and a 'more' button if more than two policies exist.

methods.name: renderCompactMessage
methods.description: Renders a compact variant message indicating the number of policies applied.

methods.name: renderDetailedMessage
methods.description: Renders a detailed message with title and description about policies.

methods.name: renderMessage
methods.description: Chooses between compact and detailed message rendering based on variant.
